history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up selfie of a young Asian couple in a romantic embrace, set against a backdrop of rolling hills and mountains bathed in the soft, warm light of sunset. The woman, on the left, has her arm around the man, her head tilted slightly towards him. She has dark, flowing hair with a few strands gently blowing across her face, and she's wearing subtle makeup with a pinkish lip color. Her attire includes a dark denim jacket layered over a necklace. The man, on the right, is looking directly at the camera with a gentle expression. He has dark, neatly styled hair and is wearing a beige t-shirt under a brown overcoat.

The background features a vast, hilly landscape with trees and patches of grass, transitioning into distant, layered mountains. The sky above is a soft gradient of pale blue and warm orange hues, indicative of dusk. The overall lighting is warm and diffused, casting a gentle glow on the couple and the landscape, creating a serene and intimate atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones – browns, beiges, greens, and the soft oranges of the sunset, with the dark denim of the woman's jacket providing a contrasting element. The mood is tender, peaceful, and deeply romantic. The image has a natural, slightly candid feel, as if captured in a private moment.
